episodes.168597: A stalled front across Central Florida once again provided support for strong showers and thunderstorms over eastern sections of South Florida. Strong wind gusts were the primary impacts.
episodes.168598: A frontal boundary across far southern Florida along with cold air aloft generated enough support for strong thunderstorms to affect Miami-Dade County during the late afternoon and early evening hours of April 3rd. Many reports of large hail were received from the Kendall area, ranging from quarter size to near golf ball size.
episodes.168660: A robust squall line moved rapidly southeast from the Gulf of Mexico along an outflow boundary initiated from a large mesoscale convective system the previous day over the northeast Gulf of Mexico.  Numerous gale to storm force wind gusts were measured.
